Chapter 6874: It’S Been A While

Chapter 6874: It’s Been A While

“The six continents?” Southconch had a strange expression; two eyes popped out of the conch: “From Guardian Alliance.”

Certain minor worlds had a connection to Guardian Alliance. Its immortals didn’t all originate from these worlds but the visitors from there always started with Guardian Alliance.

“Sure.” Bear responded.

Long ago, Guardian Alliance was a weak power, feeble before the might of Devouring Alliance. It grew stronger with the meteoric rise of Immortal Emperor Min Ren and Empress Hong Tian.

Presently, it had Enlightener and should be as strong as Heaven Assault Alliance. Nevertheless, the duo couldn’t look away from the banner.

“So what, Stygian is our world.” Big-foot said.

“We’ll start with him, it’s been a while since I last ate an immortal.” The conch said.

“Hahaha, as if I would spare you two. I will kill anyone from Devouring Alliance.” The bear pointed his banner at the opponents.

“Die!” Big-foot activated his armored boots again.

“Eat him alive!” The conch emitted a horn-like sound to summon souls, preparing to disappear.

“You’re not going anywhere!” Bear laughed and swung his banner again, releasing a tyrannical primordial wave. It easily wiped out enough dimensions to stop the conch from hiding.

“Die!” Big-foot Immortal stomped at the bear’s head again.

Bear performed a slash with his mouth to stop the foot.

“Boom!” The three shattered space and left behind chaotic zones capable of sucking in everything.

Although it was one on two, the bear had the upper hand due to his primordial banner. Nevertheless, an outcome couldn’t be determined in a short time.

Even if dismemberment occurred, immortals could still heal in the blink of an eye. Death required total and instant obliteration. The problem was that they were all grand immortals.

“Buzz.” Meanwhile, a light flashed right outside Golden Lamp, surging in Li Qiye’s direction.

Everyone was terrified by this aura, feeling as if a primal beast was opening its jaw. Of course, the target was the world’s heart.

“An immortal!” Six-foot Monarch and the others realized the intruder’s cultivation realm.

“Pop!” Another mighty foe immediately attacked, nearly extinguishing the light.

This forced the intruder to pause and defend instead.

“Boom!” The two immortals caused considerable damage to the stars nearby.

“Show yourself.” The faint aura spoke, irritated by the failed plan.

“And I ask the same of you.” The second immortal appeared among the debris as numerous sparks. Once they dissipated, an ashen light was left behind while giving the feeling of hell.

“Extinguish.” The first immortal said.

“From Fallen Ten.” Goldsilver Tree, standing below, murmured.

Rumor has it Fallen Ten only had two or perhaps three immortals left.

“Netherlight, are you too used to hiding in the abyss now?” Extinguish sneered.

“Boom!” The faint aura erupted and formed a bottomless abyss. Within were the remnants of numerous devoured worlds.

The faint aura remained at the bottom of the abyss, shining infinitely. It also looked like a chasm leading to another world.
